# Mushroom planet: r 1.5 pink candy ball with pale patches, five red-capped mushrooms. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Candy --base-color 0.9765 0.3059 0.4275 --no-slot
material new Patch --base-color 0.9686 0.5529 0.5529 --no-slot
material new Stem --base-color 1.0000 1.0000 1.0000 --no-slot
material new Cap --base-color 0.8549 0.1412 0.1412 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Shroom --subdivisions 2 --radius 1.5
material assign Candy
active Shroom
mode edit
select face where "normal.y > 0.3"
delete only-faces
select all
randomize --amount 0.05 --seed 9
mode object
active Shroom
mode edit
select mode face
select none
select random --ratio 0.22 --seed 4
material assign Patch
mode object
add mesh cylinder --name Stem0 --vertices 6 --radius 0.110 --depth 0.400 --location 1.594 -0.000 0.427 --rotation 0 75.00 -0.00
material assign Stem
add mesh ico-sphere --name Cap0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.300 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 1 0.55
apply --scale
set rotation 0 75.00 -0.00
set location 1.797 -0.000 0.481
material assign Cap
add mesh cylinder --name Stem1 --vertices 6 --radius 0.088 --depth 0.320 --location 0.264 -0.554 1.499 --rotation 0 22.27 -64.49
material assign Stem
add mesh ico-sphere --name Cap1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.240 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 1 0.55
apply --scale
set rotation 0 22.27 -64.49
set location 0.292 -0.612 1.655
material assign Cap
add mesh cylinder --name Stem2 --vertices 6 --radius 0.127 --depth 0.460 --location -1.572 -0.000 0.572 --rotation 0 70.00 -180.00
material assign Stem
add mesh ico-sphere --name Cap2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.345 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 1 0.55
apply --scale
set rotation 0 70.00 -180.00
set location -1.799 -0.000 0.655
material assign Cap
add mesh cylinder --name Stem3 --vertices 6 --radius 0.088 --depth 0.320 --location -0.944 -0.685 -1.125 --rotation 0 133.97 -144.04
material assign Stem
add mesh ico-sphere --name Cap3 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.240 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 1 0.55
apply --scale
set rotation 0 133.97 -144.04
set location -1.042 -0.756 -1.241
material assign Cap
add mesh cylinder --name Stem4 --vertices 6 --radius 0.104 --depth 0.380 --location 0.562 -0.000 -1.543 --rotation 0 160.00 -0.00
material assign Stem
add mesh ico-sphere --name Cap4 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.285 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 1 0.55
apply --scale
set rotation 0 160.00 -0.00
set location 0.630 -0.000 -1.731

select all
